title: Light Unmasks Naomi Misora in Part 2

series.summary: Light psychologically manipulates former FBI agent Naomi Misora into revealing her real name and eliminates her before she can report Kira to the police.

cuts.voiceover_text: Light is running out of time before his secret identity as Kira is completely exposed. The woman walking beside him holds proof connecting Kira to the bus hijacking. She is heading straight to police headquarters. If she speaks to the task force, Light is finished. His phone rings, but he powers it off before his father can answer. He is terrified of exposure. He needs her real name, and his only weapon is total psychological manipulation.

Light speeds up and steps directly into her path. He claims task force identities are kept confidential to protect their families from Kira. When she sharply questions how a teenager could know police secrets, Light does not flinch. He lies to her face, claiming that L personally recruited him as an elite undercover agent. He stays calm under pressure. The fabricated story lands, and she begins trusting him as an ally.

After learning she worked as an FBI agent under L, Light seizes his opening. He praises her sharp investigative intellect. He asks her to join the Kira task force directly alongside him. She looks stunned by the sudden offer. Light assures her that her talent is badly needed on the team. He explains the simple procedure to get cleared. All she needs to provide is valid identification.

Desperate to avenge her fallen fiancé, her cautious barrier completely shatters. She stops walking in the snow and faces him directly. She admits with deep regret that the name Shoko Maki was only a fake alias. Light offers a warm, reassuring smile, praising her thorough investigative habits. She opens her bag and takes out her official Japanese driver license. Her true name, Naomi Misora, is finally revealed to him on the card.

Walking together through the heavy snow, Light writes Naomi Misora into a hidden scrap of the Death Note. He keeps checking his watch as the fatal forty-second countdown ticks away. She notices his strange fixation and asks why he keeps looking at the time. Light turns toward her with a cold, triumphant smile. He whispers that it is because he is Kira. Absolute horror grips her as the death curse takes hold.
